issues.on_page: Other local receipts 3,820 = General Fund 36 (1323 Tuition received from other districts - SPED, p11) + Student Fee Fund 3,784 (Activities receipts, pp9, 22)
issues.issue: [fixed 2026-10-28: receipts[8] Other local receipts 3,820 recategorized to Extracurricular Receipts (dominant part, Student Fee Fund activities receipts 3,784)] The schedules break this broad line down, and 3,784 of 3,820 (99%) is Student Fee Fund activities receipts. The rules say to use the category that is more than half of the line, which is Extracurricular Receipts (student fees and activity receipts). The extraction uses that category for the same 3,784 in detail[124]. Charges for services/fees fits neither part.
